# PanePilot v0.3.0

PanePilot 0.3 focuses on reliable tmux ownership, exact Codex restoration, and tighter
integration between terminals and the Files workspace.

## Highlights

- Resolve tmux on SSH hosts through absolute paths, including common Homebrew and
  login-shell locations, so remote terminal creation works outside an interactive
  shell environment.
- Track Codex with its real `thread-id`, store the full provider ID in SQLite and tmux
  metadata, and resume only that exact thread. PanePilot no longer sends `/rename`.
- Recover broken project Q&A launches without retaining an unusable session record.
- Keep the latest Action output after its ephemeral tmux command exits, while retaining
  interactive input for commands that are still running.
- Make ordinary terminal Stop detach from tmux without ending the process. Confirmed
  Delete closes the exact live session before removing its PanePilot record.
- Open newly created terminals immediately, and make terminal/sidebar selections switch
  directly to the requested terminal from Actions, Files, or other project tabs.
- Make project-contained file paths in terminal output clickable, including optional
  line and column suffixes, and open them directly in Monaco.
- Download local or remote files from the Monaco preview through the native Save dialog.
- Buffer terminal-output persistence and make application shutdown tolerant of pending
  PTY data, preventing SQLite locked/closed errors during output and quit.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads.

## First-launch note

This build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm the
launch. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this GitHub repository.

New Codex sessions expose `thread-id` in PanePilot's session-local terminal-title
configuration. Restart an older Codex process before expecting exact thread discovery
from that session.
